sources.quote: Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01, controlled per control plan CP-BR220-R3.
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: The offered EN AW-6061-T6 does not meet drawing Rev C, which is in force and requires EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). The 5 Nov email quotes the withdrawn Rev B values (6061-T6, 240 MPa). An informal email cannot override the controlled drawing. 6061-T6 is also not the grade approved for BR-220 in AP-0311.

sources.quote: Any change to a requirement stated on a customer drawing, including material and finish, needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
Annex A: programs STL-Torino-27 and STL-Torino-31.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: BR-220 is on program STL-Torino-27 (Annex A). Switching the material from the drawing's 6082-T6 to 6061-T6 changes a drawing requirement, so written Stellantis approval is needed before implementation. The change also touches special characteristic SC-01 (8.3.3.3). No Stellantis approval is in the documents. The internal email is not customer approval.

sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01 | Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat

findings.why: No EN 10204 3.1 certificate or tensile result exists in the documents for the 6061-T6 bar that Alluminio B offers. A person must supply it to show actual grade, temper and Rp0.2 against SC-01. The ASL record does not store certificates.
